WHEN DOES IT RUN?

A threshold, with breathing room.

Start planning at 70% usage. Aim for a smaller working context, and wait for a completed turn before compacting.

70% of the context window · safe boundary required

This control illustrates the policy. Automatic scheduling remains experimental; moving it does not run a model.

THE PIPELINE

Selection before summarization.

01 / CAPTURE

Read the session

Normalize messages and keep tool calls attached to their results. Track the agent’s reported context usage.

02 / PRESERVE

Protect the essentials

Keep user instructions, explicit pins, and recent conversation verbatim. Pin declared pending tasks too.

03 / SELECT

Rank the evidence

Qwen3 scores relevance to the active task. Fill a selection budget with complete message groups.

04 / SUMMARIZE

Build the next context

The LLM summarizes selected history. Add protected messages and validate the budget. Native agent fallback applies if custom retention fails.

EVALUATION
Measure what matters.
Compare relevance selection against recency, protected recency, full-history LLM summaries, and LLMLingua-2. Use the same final budget and keep future questions hidden from the compactor.
Loading recorded benchmark results…
Read the evaluation protocol
Scope. Six authored synthetic coding histories: a corrected decision, exact identifiers, pending work, conflicting evidence, tool groups, and an unknown outcome. Each has a future question that the compactor never sees.
Controls. Every method shares the final memory budget and the same reader LLM. The hybrid input selection has its own smaller source budget. Runs record actual model IDs, device, token-count method, prompts, raw answers, and failures.
Grading. Hand-authored string checks measure exact field recall and appropriate abstention. These can miss semantic mistakes or fail a correct explanatory mention of an unrelated ID. Inspect raw answers. This development benchmark reuses previously inspected fixtures; it does not measure coding-task completion or prove a general quality advantage.
Tradeoff. The default policy protects all user text conservatively. The controlled benchmark uses declared pins, with all-user protection disabled; its scores do not establish performance for the default policy.

DESIGN CHOICES
A summary is a hypothesis.
Keep its evidence accessible.
Relevance is not a retention guarantee. Qwen’s yes/no score orders evidence; it is not a calibrated probability that a fact is safe to discard. Explicit preservation is enforced in code.
Preservation has a cost. If protected state fills the budget, the engine refuses replacement. Semantic discovery of every implicit constraint or unresolved decision is not guaranteed.
Originals matter. The worker keeps up to 16 source snapshots in RAM for 60 minutes. Use /loom-recall for historical evidence. They expire and do not survive a restart; this is not a durable archive.
Next experiments. Calibrate selection on real tasks; evaluate Laya separately for unresolved-decision detection; measure downstream tests, latency, and repeated-compaction drift.
